lines.speaker: Guard Captain
lines.text: Halt! ...Oh, you're the new adventurer. Good, we could use the help.

lines.speaker: Guard Captain
lines.text: The swamp to the west is crawling with mutated creatures. They're getting too close to town.

lines.speaker: Guard Captain
lines.text: If you can clear out those monsters, I'll make sure you're well compensated.

lines.speaker: Guard Captain
lines.text: That's what I like to hear! Show those monsters what you're made of.

lines.speaker: Guard Captain
lines.text: Smart to know your limits. Come back when you're stronger.
